description: Operate the official WhatsApp Business MCP with reviewable writes and captured evidence for integration checks.

tools.name: whatsapp-business-tools_mcp-request
tools.description: Send a negotiated MCP JSON-RPC request. Required: jsonrpc, method. Optional: id, params. Returns the new JsonRpcResponse.

novel_features.name: Local scope map
novel_features.description: See the captured business, account and phone relationships for an explicitly selected scope, including gaps and shared-account roles.

novel_features.name: Template component checklist
novel_features.description: Extract the values a saved template needs and flag components the MCP send tool cannot express, without sending or inventing parameter values.

novel_features.name: MCP catalog drift
novel_features.description: Compare saved MCP catalogs and identify removed tools, new required inputs and changed schema paths that could break saved commands.

novel_features.name: Captured asset changes
novel_features.description: Compare two captures of the same selected scope and see changed fields, additions and evidence gaps without mistaking incomplete pages for deletions.

novel_features.name: Cross-account template comparison
novel_features.description: Compare two explicitly chosen captured templates across accounts, with field and component differences tied to their original account and capture time.
